status_note: Candidate locators are discovery evidence only. A new activity is not verified until its rules are crosswalked, implemented, tested and assigned a verified provenance claim.

items.label: Gruhapravesha (first entry into a newly built home)
items.reason: House warming is already present, but its soft rules conflict with the exact source gates and should not be marketed as verified.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XII, 'Entering a new house,' printed pp. 52-53 (PDF pp. 56-57)

items.boundary: Keep first occupation of a newly built home separate from buying a completed house, moving between rentals and re-entry after renovation.

items.label: Seemantha (prenatal ceremony)
items.reason: Implemented as a source-verified additive profile with conservative chart gates and explicit pregnancy/medical boundaries.

source_candidates.locator: Samskara-prakarana, 'Seemantonnayana Muhurta,' verse 8, printed p. 77 (OCR lines 4157-4180)

items.boundary: Raman gives the 5th/7th pregnancy month while Muhurta Chintamani gives the 6th/8th; disclose the lineage choice. Medical care always takes precedence.

items.label: Purchase of a completed house
items.reason: Implemented as a dedicated source-verified profile; the existing Property profile remains explicitly land-for-building.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XII, 'Buying houses,' printed p. 53 (PDF p. 57)

items.boundary: The implementation does not reuse the land-purchase profile; the source's distinct Tithi, weekday, Nakshatra and preferred-Lagna formula is preserved.

items.label: Home repair or renovation commencement
items.reason: Implemented from its dedicated passage without conflating foundation laying, roof laying or Gruhapravesha.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XII, 'Repairing houses,' printed pp. 53-54 (PDF pp. 57-58)

items.boundary: The implementation separates repair commencement from painting/whitewashing, dismantling and re-entry after works.

items.label: Buying inventory for trade
items.reason: Implemented as a precise buyer-side commercial act, distinct from the overbroad Business launch profile.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter X, 'Buying for business,' printed p. 45 (PDF p. 49)

items.boundary: The implementation is distinct from founding an enterprise, deploying capital, selling inventory and ordinary consumer purchase.

items.label: Borrowing money
items.reason: The source explicitly distinguishes debtor-side timing from lending.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter X, 'Borrowing money,' printed p. 45 (PDF p. 49)
Nakshatra-prakarana, Dravyaprayoga and debt-taking, verse 27, printed pp. 38-39

items.boundary: This is astrological election guidance, not financial advice; disclose that repayment capacity and legal terms govern the decision.

items.label: Lending money
items.reason: Creditor-side rules differ materially from borrowing and should not share a profile.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter X, 'Lending money,' printed p. 45 (PDF p. 49)

items.boundary: Do not imply creditworthiness, repayment probability or investment safety from Muhurtam.

items.label: Deity installation (Prana Pratishtha)
items.reason: The activity is culturally important, but the inspected secondary source expressly directs readers to specialist authorities.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XVI, 'Installing a deity,' printed pp. 66-67 (PDF pp. 70-71)
Nakshatra-prakarana, reservoir and deity installation, printed p. 52

items.boundary: Do not automate as a complete election from the summary passage; require specialist chart and ritual review.

items.label: Garbhadhana (conception rite)
items.reason: A major samskara is missing, but health, consent and fertility claims require careful modern framing.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter VII, Nisheka and Garbhadana, printed pp. 16-17 (PDF pp. 20-21)

items.boundary: Never imply conception, fetal health or sex outcomes; consent and medical guidance are non-negotiable.

items.label: Pumsavana ceremony
items.reason: The source frames the rite around fetal sex selection, creating a serious ethical and product-safety problem.
items.boundary: Do not implement unless the owner adopts a culturally sensitive, legally reviewed framing that rejects sex-selection and medical-efficacy claims.

items.label: Agricultural operation commencement
items.reason: Both sources contain extensive agricultural elections, but ploughing, sowing, planting, pruning, reaping and storage have different rules.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XIII, 'Agriculture and farming,' printed pp. 55-58 (PDF pp. 59-62)
Nakshatra-prakarana, agricultural elections, verses 28-33, printed pp. 39-43

items.boundary: Create separate profiles per operation; never ship one generic Agriculture rule.

items.label: Commencing medicine preparation
items.reason: The activity has an exact election passage and is distinct from surgery.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XV, 'To prepare medicines,' printed p. 64 (PDF p. 68)

items.boundary: Manufacturing standards, qualified pharmacy practice and clinical evidence always take precedence; timing cannot establish safety or efficacy.

items.label: Entering a competition
items.reason: The source provides a bounded competition-entry election and explicitly warns that chance outcomes depend on the natal chart.

source_candidates.locator: Chapter XVII, 'Lotteries and competitions,' printed p. 67 (PDF p. 71)

items.boundary: Exclude gambling and lottery optimization from product claims; restrict any future profile to skill-based competition entry.
